scope: Independent read-only review of two Creative probe deltas using final-source snapshots; no own test, OCR run, ADB call, SDK action or source write.

findings.result: Blank/partial captures return no state. The persistent LUMO BAUWELT heading alone and top-right walk-mode Weiterbauen cannot identify pause. Paused requires exact central Deine Welt wartet auf dich plus central Weiterbauen in the source panel order; active requires title plus distinct Mit Lumo laufen in their observed header roles.

observe_build_pause requires two consecutive stable target observations of the same state, actual SHA equality and an unexpired60s prerequisite. pause_save dispatches one Back only if the observed state is active, then waits for paused. Already paused dispatches no Back; failed observation never retries Back. Save is read only after observed pause; optional resume retains the existing exact caption touch.

Components derive from current RGB pixels; all proposed gold regions are read within remaining deadlines, retaining distinct exact-caption word bounds. Full-region reading is opt-in and requires an exact requested caption. Jump opts in so the upper instruction cannot hide the lower-right action; source-specific jump role and same-control ambiguity checks remain. Normal learning retains early successful full-frame reads, with the component fallback only when the requested caption is absent.

Input source hash is checked before/after OCR; the final deadline check refuses a late result. Existing source/APK/run bindings, input-audit deadline, durable save assertions and Treasure movement are AST-identical on this reviewed freeze. No changed product/runtime file is included in this review.

The broadened observed felt colour proposes candidates only. Full contiguous interior, straight opposite side edges, perspective widening, gold side rims and uniqueness are still required. Actual six-piece empty save, initial first tray position, unchanged homography and subsequent real quarter-turn save check remain.

limitations: 51 PASS and offline OCR/geometry replays are existing author-run evidence, not independently rerun by this reviewer.
Actual input dispatch/Back consumption on a new emulator remains pending. The original blank-entry and missing prerequisite are proven; original native callback timing is not.
Two stable offline observations in a replay do not establish an Android device transition.
No full Studio, learning, Jump, Puzzle or game-completion acceptance is created by this source review.
Root plans a separate change to QA entry/source binding after this freeze; any subsequent source is outside these two hashes.
Only the first current61c learning PNG is copied as a repository fixture; the second remains in selected original evidence and is referenced by the authors separate real replay.
